name: Saphyroo Ltd
reason: Filing histories indicate a compulsory strike-off process was initiated in September 2026. Given the high risk of cessation and lack of genuine market operation under this entity, it is dropped per safety guidelines.

name: Interface 24/7 Limited
reason: Operates under the i247 Group as an outsourced contact center and managed service provider assisting fleet leasing companies with administration and safety programs, rather than a standalone technology solution provider.

name: Fleet Fixation Ltd
reason: Primary business is transport consultancy, operator licence application assistance, and compliance training rather than being a connected fleet solution provider.

name: Brightmile Limited
reason: Acquired by US-based Smith System and renamed to 5Keys Engage, meaning it no longer operates under its own original name.

name: Trak Global Group Limited
reason: Trading as IMS, the global entity and parent company is Trak Global Solutions Holdings (Canada) Inc., with its global HQ in Canada.

name: Tranzaura Limited
reason: Develops the FleetNow platform for driver compliance and fleet maintenance. However, its global headquarters is in Limerick, Ireland, making it a drop under the UK-only HQ rule.

name: TruTrak Limited
reason: Supplied GPS tracking hardware and the TruTrak Pro cloud platform. However, official UK corporate registry filings show the company entered voluntary liquidation in late 2025/early 2026.
